# dsh-new-session-ungrouped

> **English** — A dsh Web GUI plugin that adds **project-less chat sessions**
> ("work outside of a project", as Cursor calls it): conversations created
> **outside any workspace**, with no project `AGENTS.md`/`CLAUDE.md` and
> permissions anchored to the chat directory. It adds a **"Work outside of a
> project"** entry to the workspace picker, repairs the ungrouped
> group-header "+" (a dead button in the stock UI), routes new sessions to
> project-less mode whenever the current session is ungrouped, and unlocks
> the blank ungrouped composer. The chat directory is auto-resolved: pinned
> folder → `DSH-Chat/` under the home directory → system picker. The top "+"
> keeps the factory default behavior. (Full Chinese docs below; a complete
